title: Study-area map for a thesis or report: Kingdom of Bahrain

headline.label: of land drawn from the OpenStreetMap coastline

data: OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: coastline, motorway, trunk and primary roads, governorate boundaries (admin level 4) and cities.
method: Download the layers in one cached request, and build land polygons from the coastline.
Project to WGS 84 / UTM 39N (EPSG:32639), which fits Bahrain's location.
Add a 0.1° graticule, a 10 km scale bar and a north arrow.
A Natural Earth locator inset shows Bahrain in the Gulf and the main map extent.
limits: The map covers the main island group and leaves out the Hawar Islands in the south. Boundaries and coastline are community data and are not official boundaries. The land area follows the OpenStreetMap coastline, including reclaimed land drawn there.
